name: Call metering screen loads and handles an empty connection list
description: Opens the call metering screen and confirms it renders correctly whether or not any landline connections are on file.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as accounts@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2027
Assert the call metering screen loads without a server error and shows its heading
Assert that either a list of billable landline connections is shown, or a clear empty state explains that no landline connections are available. A blank page or an error page must fail this test.
